construction.name: cross_base_envelope_axial_subdivision
construction.proof:
Cross-base envelope followed by whole axial subdivision

For one complete source owner c_i+R_i P, with P=B_p x[-h/2,h/2], first place one envelope E=B_q x[-kH/2,kH/2] by E+b subset alpha P. Here q differs from p, b=(bx,by,0) is one common canonical planar offset, and alpha>0 is shared across every source owner. Use the fixed identity canonical registration, not independent rotations. The planar offset and minimum planar alpha are derived from all actual canonical edge-facet inequalities; then alpha must also satisfy alpha*h >= kH. Retain all source owners, their exact native rotations, source labels and original authors.

The complete target children have centers alpha*c_i + R_i*(b+(j-(k-1)/2)*H*e3), frames R_i, and indices (i,j), j=0,...,k-1. Their union is exactly alpha*c_i+R_i*(b+E). Within a parent, axial intervals tile the full envelope, so distinct sibling interiors are separated by the inherited axial planes. Children with different parents lie inside the same uniformly dilated complete source owners, hence inherit valid separators from that same source packing. This uses no common-axis assumption between different parents.

Decoder: each target retains source i, axial slot j, and the parent's full native quaternion. Remove the slot offset and common canonical b in the inherited frame, then divide the global center by alpha. A final common recentering and rational center dilation is recorded separately; its native rounding errors are explicit. Strict native sibling, cross-parent and host-wall tests remain mandatory.

Table-first scope: source inventory is the frozen cross_base_prism_transfer INPUTS.json; all current retained private gates are refreshed separately. Test integer k>=2 with k*n<=100, only different polygon bases and supported target heights1,3/2,2,3. The floating screen is only a proposal generator. Exact outward interval canonical inclusion, complete parent checks and full native geometry precede any record claim. Previous same-base common-axis subdivision and arbitrary-axis collar-envelope subdivision are controls, not evidence of this new cross-base inclusion.
